caption: The drawing is done in pencil on an off-white or light beige paper, depicting three views of a metal candle holder. The central, largest image shows the candle holder from an angled front view, highlighting its symmetric, curved metal frame and a circular handle on the left side, attached to a flat dish base that supports a central candle socket with a screw-threaded top. The metal frame curves outward and upward from the base, with horizontal supports joining the two sides and forming loops at the top. Positioned above and to the left is a smaller front elevation drawing of the same candle holder, clearly outlining its symmetric, ornate metal frame and dish base. To the right, another smaller drawing shows a side profile of the holder, emphasizing the widening dish at the bottom, the vertical shank, and the attached handle curving to the right. The drawing is rendered in grayscale, using shading and line work to detail the three-dimensional forms and contours of the object. The artist’s name, JANET RIZA, is inscribed in capital letters at the bottom right of the image.
title: Taper Jack
